summary: Live Nation Entertainment filed an 8-K on October 9, 2026, disclosing that on October 7 it priced a private offering of $730 million 7.125% senior notes due 2032 and €600 million 6.125% senior notes due 2032, both at par, with closing expected October 15, 2026. Proceeds fund full redemption of its 6.500% Senior Secured Notes due 2027 and general corporate purposes; guarantees come from the company and domestic restricted subsidiaries backing its senior secured credit facilities. Cross-currency swaps convert the dollar tranche into roughly €652 million, blending to about 5.89%. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation.
